description: Final UI animation is displayed above a separate sound-design timeline; this is a result-and-process showcase rather than a readable sound tutorial.

techniques.name: UI button and panel staging
techniques.evidence: A logo becomes a rounded New button, followed by a moving interface and colored rounded shapes.
implementation: Use an original UI card or button.
Animate scale and position with a single easing family.
Add user-supplied sound effects only with explicit timeline metadata.

typography: Small interface labels and rounded button text in the top result square.
composition: Top square is Final Video; lower rectangle is Sound Design timeline. Treat the lower region as editor UI.
effects: Logo/button scaling, UI pan/zoom and rounded shape transitions; audio alignment cannot be established from still frames.
easing: Exact source interpolation is uncertain. Any stored guidance is an original cubic-ease design recommendation, not a recovered curve.

tutorial.interface: The lower panel shows a multitrack sound-design editor timeline.
tutorial.animationRegions: Only the upper Final Video square is the finished animation.
tutorial.limitations: Track names and exact sound-effect timing are unreadable; no audio transcription or sound identification was performed.

uncertainties: Exact font family and original keyframe/easing parameters are not recoverable from these sampled frames.
Intervals are approximate observations, not audio-aligned or frame-precise annotations.
reviewer: Codex visual review of sampled source frames
